payload.title: G2: Function input, rule banner, function checks (f(3) is 10) and a table ask (M, most important)
payload.description:
Most important gap: it enables the function throughline (R1 follow-ups).
Acceptance:
- Given a lesson with a function card, the student can enter x and see the result in the box.
- A rule banner shows the rule, e.g. f(x) = x squared plus 1.
- A check 'f(3) is 10' can be written in lesson.yaml and is run by the loader and the browser.
- A 'table' ask has the student fill x and f(x) rows; wrong cells get a specific reply.
- Covered by Gherkin features under features/.
